## Notes

Frontier Developments; alpha 2016-03-22; Windows release 2016-11-17; Console Edition 2020. Hybrid spline and piece coaster builder, modular structures, voxel terrain, Career/Challenge/Sandbox, Steam Workshop and Frontier Workshop; spiritual successor to RollerCoaster Tycoon 3.
